# Jaymurti Traders — Birla Opus Paints Showroom

> Jaymurti Traders (जयमूर्ति ट्रेडर्स) is an authorized Birla Opus paint dealer and architectural colour showroom located in Shukul Bazar, Baskhari, Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Jaymurti Traders (जयमूर्ति ट्रेडर्स)
- **Authorized Brand:** Birla Opus Paints (Grasim Industries / Aditya Birla Group)
- **Location:** Shukul Bazar, Baskhari, Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh - 224129, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 87566 59035
- **Operating Hours:** 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Monday – Sunday)
- **Primary Website:** https://jaymurtitraders.vercel.app/
- **Google Maps:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/V1wvtKAGnH5RUG1cA
- **Google Business Profile:** https://share.google/Nyju9PoRuINGGoD83
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/paintwalebhaiya45/

## Core Offerings & Digital Tools

1. **159 Verified Birla Opus Shade Database:** Complete verified catalogue of Birla Opus paint shades indexed by tone family, exact hex codes, and official shade numbers.
2. **Product Catalogue:** Interior luxury emulsions, exterior weather-defense coatings, enamels, wood finishes, and waterproofing solutions.
3. **Room Shade Studio:** Interactive lookbook and dual side-by-side comparison studio showcasing 12 architectural spaces across 166 real shade variations.
4. **Colour Capsule:** Editorial mood lookbook featuring 50 curated architectural spreads and tonal pairings.
5. **Surface Studio & Textures:** Metallic textures, stucco finishes, stone washes, and designer wall applications.
6. **Smart Paint Estimator:** Calculator for carpet area, surface type, coats, and litres required.
7. **On-Site Colour Consultation:** Personalized shade guidance, digital daylight sampling, and painter recommendations across Ambedkar Nagar district.
